initial_application: The Jira comments cite svn @10162. Git commit 83f1205cc1f012816734622c56ee12d93a24212d corresponds to that application and changed source/conformance-module.html from "Refine the contents of valuesets" to "Reference the Value Sets that specify the content of coded elements," with a small surrounding StructureDefinition wording clarification.
additional_context: The current source/conformance-module.html preserves that replacement, publish.ini lists conformance-module.html as an active published and special page, and nearby conformance/StructureDefinition pages use the same reference/use-ValueSets framing. Current-source, Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no stale exact wording or conflicting final decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current FHIR core source already conveys the resolved clarification and no source edit is needed.
